sources.scope: Software's nominal ISO bolt tensile-area calculation: At=pi/4*(d-.9382P)^2; d3 approximately d-1.2268P; d2 approximately d-.6495P. M5 coarse pitch .8mm. Not actual tolerances or supplier bolt certification.

sources.publisher: NASA Technical Reports Server, Lewis Research Center fastener design material
sources.scope: Metric nominal tensile stress area formula pi/4*(D-.9382P)^2. Not an installed ReGrip connector compliance law.

limitations: Nominal basic-profile axial sensitivities only; rounded root coefficient is ideal geometry, not minimum tolerance diameter.
Tensile stress area is not finite head/nut/flank/contact/preload compliance.
E is conditional, not source-backed minimum for a certified purchased part.
No source licenses replacing smooth-envelope CAD with fictitious tied threads or assigning physical stack PASS.
